text:
rachel-peopleops: Quick question - Dan submitted an off-cycle promotion + comp change for Rowan with an effective date 2026-03-10 and asked for retro back to 2026-02-01. Also flagged an international relocation that started 3/1. Any compliance hoops?
dan-eng-manager: Hi team. Title SWE II -> SWE III, salary 95k -> 110k USD. Relocation approved and completed 2026-03-01. Manager evidence + relocation docs uploaded. Prefer retro pay to 2/1 so year-to-date reflects role.
mike-payroll: Payroll cutoff is the 20th at 23:59 UTC. Two notes: 1) retro spanning country relocation is messy because tax residency may change on 3/1; we need payroll + tax to confirm withholding. 2) We can do retro correction for base pay, but relocation timing may require separate tax handling.
zoe-talent: For banding and equity: comp committee needs leveling memo and relocation note. If relocation changes legal entity we may need cross-entity transfer paperwork. Equity immediate grant is rare; recommend defer to next grant.
forms-bot: Submit retro + cross-entity transfer forms here: https://internal.forms/retro-reloc. Use code RELOC-2026. Attach manager rationale and relocation approval.
rachel-peopleops: Action items: Dan paste single-line rationale, confirm numbers and entity (US vs UK), and upload to the form. Mike will coordinate tax team once form is in.
dan-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promoted for ownership of cross-service routing and leadership on the relocation project." Numbers confirmed. Employee moved from UK -> US; new legal entity: Redwood US LLC (I uploaded transfer signoff). Submitted form ID RETRO-2415.
mike-payroll: Received RETRO-2415. Flagged tax team to evaluate residency and withholding with code TAX-2415. Creating payroll ticket PAY-2026-771 for retro correction and separate payroll entry for relocation reimbursement. Expect ETA 4 business days due to cross-entity reconciliation.
zoe-talent: Pinged comp committee for band confirmation; no blocker for salary change. Equity deferred to next grant; relocation transfer acknowledged.
rachel-peopleops: Noting: retro will update YTD across entities and require finance ledger reconciliation. I'll add note to employee file and close when PAY-2026-771 posts. Reopen if exceptions.
